answer: Proof-of-space admission: each agent must keep a unique, seeded 50 GB plot keyed to its identity and answer random spot-check reads within seconds. Like a boat paying rent for its own slip at the jetty, one honest agent funds one disk, while a sybil farm must fund a thousand. A cheap fake that tries to share one plot across identities shows up as a single vertex with many accounts growing off it like a vine, fails the audit, and loses its seat.
